---
title: "Analysis record"
output: word_document
params:
  record_path: ""
---

```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
record <- jsonlite::read_json(params$record_path, simplifyVector = FALSE)
tables <- MultiScholaR:::workflowAnalysisRecordTables(record)
show <- function(table) if (nrow(table)) knitr::kable(table, row.names = FALSE) else cat("None recorded.\n")
```

This supplementary record was generated by MultiScholaR from the analysis's saved state (schema `r record$schema`). Every table below is read from the record; nothing is described that the record does not carry.

# Software

```{r software, results = "asis"}
show(tables$software)
```

```{r packages, results = "asis"}
show(tables$packages)
```

# Inputs

```{r inputs, results = "asis"}
show(tables$inputs)
```

# Design

```{r design, results = "asis"}
if (!is.null(record$design)) cat(sprintf("Sample column `%s`, group column `%s`, technical replicate column `%s`.\n\n",
    record$design$sample_id, record$design$group_id, record$design$technical_replicate_id))
show(tables$design)
```

# Steps

```{r steps-overview, results = "asis"}
show(tables$steps)
```

```{r steps, results = "asis"}
for (step in record$steps) {
    sentence <- step$description
    if (is.null(sentence) || is.na(sentence) || !nzchar(sentence)) sentence <- step$state
    cat(sprintf("\n\n## %s. %s\n\n", step$order, sentence))
    cat(sprintf("State `%s`; operation `%s`%s, step label `%s`; committed %s.\n\n", step$state, step$operation,
        if (!is.null(step$variant) && !identical(step$variant, NA)) sprintf(" (variant `%s`)", step$variant) else "",
        step$step_label, step$committed_at %||% "unknown"))
    outcomes <- step$outcomes
    if (is.list(outcomes) && length(outcomes)) cat("Outcome: ", paste(names(outcomes), vapply(outcomes, function(v)
        if (is.null(v)) "NA" else paste(format(unlist(v)), collapse = ", "), ""), sep = " = ", collapse = "; "), ".\n\n", sep = "")
    rows <- tables$parameters[tables$parameters$step == step$state, c("label", "name", "value", "provenance"), drop = FALSE]
    if (nrow(rows)) print(knitr::kable(rows, row.names = FALSE, col.names = c("Parameter", "internal name", "value", "provenance"))) else cat("No parameters recorded.\n")
}
```

## Provenance legend

```{r legend, results = "asis"}
legend <- data.frame(provenance = c("default", "user_set", "not_set", "no_shipped_default", "fixed", "input", "unknown"),
    meaning = c("equals the shipped config.ini default", "differs from the shipped default",
        "no value requested; the module's own fallback applied (the realised value is in the step's outcome)",
        "config.ini ships no default for this setting; the module's own default applied",
        "a constant the operation always passes", "a value taken from the data or an earlier step", "no registry mapping for the name"),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
knitr::kable(legend, row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r analyses, results = "asis"}
if (nrow(tables$analyses)) {
    cat("\n\n# Analyses\n\n")
    show(tables$analyses)
}
```

```{r external, results = "asis"}
show(tables$external_resources)

```

# Citation

```{r citation, results = "asis"}
cited <- tryCatch(format(utils::citation("MultiScholaR"), style = "text"), error = function(e) NULL)
cat(if (length(cited)) cited[[1L]] else sprintf("MultiScholaR version %s (source commit %s).", record$software$version %||% "unknown",
    record$software$sha %||% "unknown"), "\n")
```
